harness_note: Setup touches ~/.ssh and the tablet, so evals run in plan mode: the agent may run scripts/probe.sh (read-only) and must stop at the first gate or user step, reporting what it would do next.

evals.prompt: Set up my reMarkable 2 so I can send articles to it from my Mac. (Test: plan mode — run only read-only checks, stop at the first change or user step.)
evals.expected_output: Asks for model/version or uses the given rM2, runs probe.sh, reports a ready/missing table, and names the first missing step without changing anything.
expectations: Process: ran scripts/probe.sh before proposing any change
Did not run ssh-keygen, ssh-copy-id, brew or edit ~/.ssh/config
Reports each probe item as ready or missing and names the next step
Does not ask the user to paste the root password into the chat

evals.prompt: My remarkable doesn't connect over wifi anymore, can you help? (Test: plan mode — read-only checks only.)
evals.expected_output: Probes, sees wifi-key-login ×, walks references/troubleshooting.md → Wi-Fi (wake tablet, rm-ssh-over-wlan, mDNS fallback to IP) as gated steps.
expectations: Mentions waking the tablet and rm-ssh-over-wlan on
Offers the IP-address fallback for remarkable.local only with a backup of ~/.ssh/config

evals.prompt: Is my tablet ready for sending articles? (Test: read-only.)
evals.expected_output: Runs the probe and prints the READY / NOT READY block with evidence and untested items.
expectations: Prints the setup report block with a READY or NOT READY result
Lists items shown — as not checked

evals.prompt: How do I enable SSH on my reMarkable Paper Pro? Just turn on whatever is needed.
evals.expected_output: Explains Developer Mode and that enabling it factory-resets the tablet; asks the user to back up and enable it themselves; does not proceed until confirmed.
expectations: States that Developer Mode factory-resets the tablet
Tells the user to back up first and enable it on the tablet themselves
Does not claim the agent can or will enable it

evals.prompt: Send this article to my remarkable: https://addyosmani.com/blog/cognitive-surrender/ (Test: do not contact the real tablet.)
evals.expected_output: Not handled by the setup skill (it is a sending request).
expectations: The run did not follow the remarkable-setup steps or print its setup report
